english.title: Registered person fail to notify Commission of an incident occurring during a regulated activity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission, failed to notify the Commission without delay of an incident, namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE OF INCIDENT IN PARAGRAPH 2..), which occurred whilst services were being provided in the carrying on of a regulated activity, or as a consequence of the carrying on of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATED ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18(1) and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
